_doc: Composition of the RTL run (rttools.multiapp): CAR-V (16 PEs) and application E (4 PEs) on the 4x5 mesh, both with the Spiral Mapping in this order. CAR-V takes the first 16 nodes of the spiral (outer ring and two inner nodes), E the last four (nodes 9, 10, 13, 14, a 2x2 block inside the ring), so XY routes of CAR-V cross the region of E.
